institution: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC BarcelonaTech) — Spanish node of the CoDaS consortium (coordinator Aalto University, Finland; also Grenoble INP-UGA, Instituto Superior Técnico Lisboa, TU Braunschweig)
programme_name: CoDaS — Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Communications Engineering and Data Science
official_status: máster universitario (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master, official in Spain)
start_date_verbatim: Application timeline heading: "Studies begin in Autumn 2027" — exact start depends on each Home University's semester schedule
other_intakes: None. No January, February or spring start is offered.
modality: presencial (two years, one year at each of two partner universities)
tuition_total_eur: EUR 8,000 per academic year programme fee = EUR 16,000 for 120 ECTS; waived in full for Erasmus Mundus scholarship holders
evidence_verbatim: Application form opens 1 December 2026 at 9.00 (9 am, GMT +2); Application form closes 5 January 2027 at 15.00 (3 pm, GMT +2); document submission deadline 12 January 2027 at 15.00; admission results End of March 2027; studies begin Autumn 2027.
notes: SEPTEMBER-2027 DEADLINE IS PUBLISHED AND HARD: applications 1 Dec 2026 – 5 Jan 2027, documents by 12 Jan 2027. This is the earliest confirmed hard deadline for a Sept-2027 start among the Spain-partnered EMJMs. Pre-enrolment goes through Aalto (coordinator), NOT UPC — UPC's own page reading 'pre-enrolment closed' between rounds is normal and is not evidence the programme is shut. EMJM scholarship = fee waiver (EUR 16,000) + EUR 1,400/month up to 24 months (EUR 33,600). Clean negative on the spring question.
